title: One tree, applied: the Inbox cards move into the sessions store

chat.text: The date folders are gone and the decision is made; this is the apply. A resolver turns a card id into its folder (new place if it exists, else the old), every caller switches to it, then the card folders move by script with relink and a proven undo, and old card links keep opening. Checked on the AI page, the Inbox, a card and a session page before merging.
